content_sections.heading: ChPA Senior Accounts Officer (Class I) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.chennai_port_authority_chpa_tamil_nadu: Finance Department, Chennai Port Authority, Chennai

For absorption / deputation: officers holding analogous posts, or Accounts Officer Gr.I in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; a degree from a recognized university is essential.

content_sections.heading: ChPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. RC2/2595/Sr.AO/2026/GA gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ChPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Degree from a recognized university (essential for absorption / deputation); Officers holding analogous posts or post of Accounts Officer Gr.I in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Trust Experience: 5 years regular service in the grade of Accounts Officer Gr.I (Rs.9100-15100) in a Major Port Trust, or holding an analogous post Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on 30 December 2026) Other conditions: Open to eligible Officers of Major Port Authorities only Applications must come through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, without ACRs / APARs or without enclosures will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on absorption / deputation basis, governed by terms and conditions prescribed by the Central Government Period of probation 2 years as per the Recruitment Rules

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications through proper channel

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copies of educational qualifications and experience Undertaking not to withdraw if selected (Annexure-5) Self-attested passport size photo affixed on the application Photocopy of ACRs / APARs for last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer not below Deputy Head of Department No Objection Certificate and Vigilance / Administrative Clearance (Annexure-2) Complete service details in Annexure-4 format

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ChPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply through the Online Application Portal (OAP) of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in). Send a print-out of the online application through proper channel. Enclose copies of educational qualifications and experience, an undertaking not to withdraw if selected, and affix a self-attested passport size photo. Parent Port forwards the application with ACRs / APARs, willingness, NOC, vigilance clearance and service details. Application must reach the Secretary, Chennai Port Authority, Rajaji Salai, Chennai – 600 001 on or before 30.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Crucial date for determining eligibility is 30.12.2026 Details of any major or minor penalty in the last 10 years must be sent with documents Veracity of University Certificates and recognition of the Degree may be ensured and certified by the Port
